# Twelve Data

> > Financial market data API platform providing real-time and historical data for stocks, forex, cryptocurrencies, and indices across global exchanges including KRX, HKEX, LSE, Euronext, and Cboe.

Twelve Data offers comprehensive APIs for accessing financial market data with support for technical indicators, time-series analysis, and WebSocket streaming. The platform serves developers, FinTech companies, and enterprises with tools including Python libraries, Excel add-ins, and Google Sheets integration.

## Key Topics

- Real-time market data
- Historical financial data
- Forex API & exchange rates
- Time-series analysis
- Technical indicators
- WebSocket streaming
- Global exchanges (KRX, HKEX, TWSE, Euronext, LSE, Cboe)
- Cryptocurrency data (Binance)
- Python integration (TDClient)
- Excel & Google Sheets add-ons
- JSON/CSV data formats
- Stock market indices (DAX, FTSE 100, Nifty 50, CAC 40)
- API documentation
- Enterprise FinTech solutions

## Core Data Products

- [Forex APIs (Real Time & Historical)](https://twelvedata.com/forex): Forex & metals data API for 2000+ pairs with real-time streaming
- [Global Indices APIs (Real Time & Historical)](https://twelvedata.com/indices): Global stock market indices API: DAX, FTSE 100, Nifty 50, CAC 40 data

## API Documentation & Tools

- [API Request Builder](https://twelvedata.com/request-builder): No-code tool to construct API requests for financial data in JSON/CSV
- [Twelve Data Excel Add-in Installation Guide for Windows](https://twelvedata.com/news/twelve-data-excel-add-in-installation-guide-for-windows): Step-by-step Excel Add-in installation guide for Windows users
- [Twelve Data Google Sheets Add-on Documentation](https://twelvedata.com/news/twelve-data-google-sheets-add-on-documentation): Google Sheets Add-on function reference and integration guide

## Tutorials & Guides

- [Forex API: Accessing the $6.6 Trillion Market](https://twelvedata.com/news/forex-api-accessing-the-66-trillion-market): Tutorial on accessing Forex market data via Twelve Data API
- [Get High-Quality Financial Data Directly into Python](https://twelvedata.com/news/get-high-quality-financial-data-directly-into-python): Python tutorial using TDClient library with pandas integration
